system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: a grid divided into two halves by line labeled m. A triangle is drawn on the left side.]
Draw the reflection of the triangle. Line m is the mirror line.

Figure, described in words:
A square grid 6 units wide and 6 units tall. A vertical dashed line labeled "m" at the bottom divides the grid vertically down the center (3 units from the left edge and 3 units from the right edge). On the left side of line m, a right triangle is drawn along the grid lines with vertices at:
- 2 units from the left edge and 2 units above the bottom edge (the right-angled vertex, located 1 unit to the left of line m)
- 1 unit from the left edge and 2 units above the bottom edge (located 2 units to the left of line m)
- 2 units from the left edge and 5 units above the bottom edge (1 unit below the top edge, located 1 unit to the left of line m).
The vertical leg of the triangle is 3 units long and lies along the grid line 1 unit to the left of line m; the horizontal base is 1 unit long and lies 2 units above the bottom edge.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Reflect each vertex of the triangle across the vertical mirror line m (3 units from the left edge), keeping each vertex the same distance from m on the opposite side. The triangle's right-angled vertex, 1 unit left of m at height 2, reflects to a point 1 unit right of m at height 2. The vertex 2 units left of m at height 2 reflects to a point 2 units right of m at height 2. The top vertex 1 unit left of m at height 5 reflects to a point 1 unit right of m at height 5. Draw straight segments connecting these three reflected points to form the mirror-image triangle on the right side of line m: a vertical leg 3 units long on the grid line 1 unit right of m (from height 2 to height 5), a horizontal base 1 unit long at height 2 from the grid line 1 unit right of m to the grid line 2 units right of m, and a hypotenuse joining the point 2 units right of m at height 2 to the point 1 unit right of m at height 5.
